description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableConnectionIdPlaceholder' that implements the 'ConnectionIdPlaceholder' interface. It provides methods for handling a specific placeholder 'id' related to connection IDs, including support checks, resolution logic, and supported placeholder listing.

classes.name: ImmutableConnectionIdPlaceholder
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ConnectionIdPlaceholder, handling placeholder 'id' for ConnectionId objects.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix for the placeholder, which is 'connection'.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list of supported placeholder names, currently only 'id'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given placeholder name is supported, i.e., equals 'id'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder to a string if the connection ID is not a dummy and the placeholder matches 'id'.
